name: android

frames.best_why: Phone is largest and centred with the mountain photo fully framed inside the rounded screen.

tagline: A tall phone frame shows a photo inside its rounded screen.
summary: An SVG mockup of a phone with rounded corners, a small centred front camera and slim side buttons, holding whatever image or looping video you pass in.
appearance: A tall narrow phone silhouette with heavily rounded corners and a thin light bezel, floating on a black stage. A small dot marks the front camera near the top, and a mountain photo above a sea of clouds fills the screen.
behaviour: Static phone frame; only an optional looping video placed in it would move. It does not respond to the pointer or clicks.
demo_content: A sunset photo of a snowy mountain above a sea of clouds.
search_phrases: phone bezel to display an image
play a video inside a phone shell
use_when: Showing app screenshots or a demo video on a marketing page or store listing.
avoid_when: The screen needs to be interactive: this is a flat image or video, not a live app.
customise: Size, image URL and optional video URL are props; the frame and bezel colours come from hardcoded light and dark classes.
weight_why: One inline SVG with a single clipped image; no script or animation loop.

a11y.note: The frame is an SVG with no title or alt, so a screen reader gets no description of the mocked-up screen.

issues: The screen photo has no alt text, so its content is invisible to assistive tech.
polish_why: Tidy and accurate phone silhouette, but it is a plain frame with no extra detail.
